fieldCorrections.evidence: Live battery: browser-UA on /fr/ + /fr/categorie-produit/armes-a-feu/ + /fr/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products → all 200. curl/8.0.1 UA → 403 (edge UA filter active). XSS payload (browser UA) → 403 + CF block page. SQLi payload → 200 (not blocked). 10-burst browser UA → 10/10 200s (no rate-limit on legitimate UA). Net: Cloudflare with rule-selective edge filtering — bot UA + payload signatures fire 403, normal traffic always 200. SKILL.md line 200 vs 205 are mutually exclusive on this case. Operational impact (perPage drops to 20 in catalog-crawler.ts) is real but production crawler uses browser UA which returns 200. DB's 'cloudflare-passive' is defensible. Operator should decide; recording 'active' is the conservative pick.
fieldCorrections.method: 5-vector WAF battery with normal-path browser UA verification
fieldCorrections.skillGap: SKILL.md needs explicit rule: rule-fired 403 on synthetic payloads (XSS, bot UA) when normal browser-UA paths return 200 → keep cloudflare-passive; rule-fired 403 on a real crawler path → cloudflare-active.
